thesis: Book is currently all cash despite prior thesis calling for near-full deployment, so this is an initial buildout, not a drift trade. Bottleneck stays compute/memory (MU, HBM demand) with power as the binding secondary constraint (PWR, GEV, ETN on grid capex); fabrication anchored in monopoly names (TSM, AMAT, LRCX, ASML) rather than the KLAC print, which looks like a data artifact given the -85.8%
